hypothesis: A separate checked replay entry point can reject unsupported reconstruction targets before execution, fail on a bound tensor-digest mismatch, and preserve existing outputs under normal and optimized Python without changing frozen research code.
primary_comparator: Archived minkron-fast-20261021-v1/replay.py control flow with synthetic files and stubbed tensor operations only.
primary_metric: False-success, overwrite and late-validation counts over explicit control-flow/filesystem cases.
minimum_useful_effect: Zero false successes and overwrites in the declared tests, with valid matching synthetic control accepted.
success_rule: Demonstrate the original failure behaviors without real model execution; validate all 21 saved target plans; pass failure controls for unsupported targets, malformed schedules, mismatched/false/missing replay receipts, child failures, missing or changed inputs, existing outputs and concurrent destination creation. Keep checks active under python -O.
futility_rule: Stop and report any safety or source-binding obligation that cannot be met without changing archived evidence or running an unapproved model. Do not weaken a hash match into numerical closeness.

authorization.user_approval_reference: 2026-10-23 donor contribution request and subsequent authorization for multiple focused PRs within the original 480-minute budget.
authorization.approved_resources: Existing session CPU and standard library for metadata inspection, synthetic-file tests and stubbed control flow only. No real PyTorch/model execution, training, model evaluation, checkpoint deserialization, corpus download, paid services or official-test access.
authorization.max_walltime: Within original session ending approximately 2026-10-23 14:04 UTC; no new research after 12:04 UTC.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: Bounded small unit tests; no model computation.

design.arms: All 18 saved screen targets and three saved continuation targets; no new arm.
design.control_rationale: Exercise command status and filesystem behavior with fake computation; this does not test model mathematics or quality.
design.matching_track: E00 reconstruction engineering, independent of open PR #18's scalar audit.
design.compute_accounting: Test walltime only; no model performance inference.

data.dataset_versions: Saved manifests only. A later authorized real invocation must verify required local array hashes before launching the archived runner.

execution.runtime_versions: Python standard library; record actual interpreter in verification receipt.
execution.resolved_writable_output: New result directory and synthetic scratch files within the donor session folder.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: Independent clean worktree at the pinned base. No parent evidence mutation. Simulate a concurrently created final path in tests.
execution.fidelity_tolerances: Exact recorded model-tensor SHA-256 equality; no tolerance relaxation. No tensor arithmetic qualification in this run.
execution.canary_matrix: Positive matching synthetic child, mismatch/false flag, invalid JSON, nonzero child, unsupported targets, missing/corrupted source or arrays, existing output, output race, and optimized Python.
execution.cost_estimate: No install, accelerator, external data or cloud access.

evaluation.primary_endpoint: Control-flow and non-overwrite unit tests; no model score.
evaluation.canonical_precision: Not applicable to stubbed control flow

evidence.source_manifest: INPUTS.json with pinned parent source and metadata hashes
evidence.preservation_policy: Retain completed parent evidence and any failed real replay output; never overwrite the requested final path.
evidence.cleanup_receipt: Synthetic test files only may be cleaned; no unrelated workload or artifact.

decision.next_experiment: Actual checkpoint reconstruction remains separately authorized work; these engineering tests cannot claim it passed.
